start.name_en: Valve Chamber No. 9, Chengjiang Town, Beibei District
start.geocode_source: EIA Table 2.2-22 (row 2) states '9#阀室 | 北碚区澄江镇' at trunk km 15.22. Coordinate is the document's own precise GPS for the trunk's 嘉陵江 (Jialing River) crossing point at this location: '嘉陵江 重庆市北碚区澄江镇 29°55'47"N 106°23'2"E' (converted: 29.929722N/106.383889E). Note: 澄江镇 is in 北碚区 (Beibei District), not 璧山区 (Bishan District, this PID's END) -- confirmed by 8 separate corroborating mentions of '北碚区澄江镇' across the EIA text, so this is a genuine inter-district branch, not an intra-Bishan one.

end.name_zh: 璧山区（璧山供气支线/壁山供气管道，OCR原文误作'壁山'）
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '璧山区,重庆市' -> OSM relation 2693396, district administrative-boundary centroid (addresstype=district; a duplicate 'city'-type node at 106.2019243E/29.5792182N also returned, same district, not used). Matches GEM's generic EndLocation='Bishan'.

corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the Phase 2 trunk at 9#阀室 in 澄江镇 (Beibei District, at the trunk's Jialing River crossing) and running into 璧山区 (Bishan District) to serve local gas demand -- crosses a district boundary (Beibei -> Bishan) despite the branch's common name referencing only the destination district. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '壁山供气管道' [OCR for 璧山] among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches distributed across 大足区、潼南区、璧山区、合川区、渝北区、长寿区、垫江县、湖北省巴东县 (combined 135.6km). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
researcher_notes: Start point is unusually well-sourced -- an exact river-crossing GPS coordinate from the EIA itself, not an inferred/geocoded proxy. Initially assumed (from background knowledge) that 澄江镇 was in 璧山区 since that is commonly cited as Bishan's seat; the EIA document consistently and repeatedly states '北碚区澄江镇' instead, so the working hypothesis was corrected to trust the well-corroborated document text -- the branch genuinely runs from a Beibei District valve chamber into Bishan District. End point is district-level only for the same reason as the other branches (Phase 3 branch-specific EIA not yet public).
